plugins.name: qatlas
plugins.description: Shared Qatlas infrastructure with a work loop for goal setting, planning, execution and review, plus explicit core and workspace management.

plugins.name: qatlas-dev
plugins.description: Code pack: the laziest solution that actually works, in three levels, plus a review skill. Requires qatlas.

plugins.name: qatlas-design
plugins.description: Design pack: researched art direction, a strict no-ornament house style checked in a real browser, and a screenshot loop for web pages and app screens. Needs Node 22 and Chrome. Requires qatlas.

plugins.name: qatlas-council
plugins.description: Optional advisory pack: on explicit call only, starts independent subagents for ideas and plans, and with arch for technical architecture decisions. Requires qatlas.
